parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The number of the page to return. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: FirewallConfigureStatus
parameters.description:
The configuration status of the VPC boundary firewall. Valid values:

- **configured**: The VPC boundary firewall is configured.

- If you omit this parameter, the operation queries the access control policies for all VPC boundary firewalls.

parameters.name: FirewallId
parameters.description: The instance ID of the VPC boundary firewall.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the response. Valid values:

- **zh** (default): Chinese

- **en**: English

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. The maximum value is 50.
